meta.name: add-slack
meta.description: Add Slack channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 将 Slack 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用里发送或接收 Slack 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send or receive Slack messages in your app.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 把 Slack 接入对话：复制并注册 Slack 适配器、安装固定版本依赖，引导你创建 Slack 应用、填写凭证，之后 agent 便能在 Slack 频道或私信中收发消息，并使用 Slack 的 mrkdwn 语法发消息。
howto.when: 当你想给 Claude 添加 Slack 频道、创建 Slack 应用或配置监听方式（Socket 或 Webhook）时，此技能会接管这些步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 Slack 接入进来
say.note: 开始复制适配器、注册并安装依赖。

say.text: Slack 用 Socket 模式，不走公网
say.note: 引导创建应用并填写 app token。

say.text: Slack 走 Webhook 投递，我来填公网地址
say.note: 会设置签名密钥和事件订阅。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude integrates Slack via the Chat SDK: it copies and registers the Slack adapter, installs a pinned dependency, walks you through creating a Slack app and storing credentials, then the agent can send/receive messages in Slack channels and DMs using Slack's mrkdwn.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Slack channel, create the Slack app, or configure delivery (Socket or webhook).

say_en.note: Walks through app creation and app token.
Sets signing secret and event subscription.
